highlights.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
highlights.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.

highlights.title: SoftBank CDS Hits 3-Year High as OpenAI Risks Stay in Focus
highlights.description: SoftBank Group Corp.’s credit default swaps rose to the highest level since 2023 as traders assessed risks surrounding OpenAI, one of SoftBank’s biggest bets.

highlights.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
highlights.description: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

alsoIn.title: SK hynix reportedly discussing US memory chip manufacturing with Intel — options include leasing Ohio plant or forming joint venture with other AI hyperscalers

highlights.title: Will AI really destroy humanity? Pioneers who created the tech weigh in
highlights.description: AI pioneers and "godfathers" have weighed in on Anthropic and OpenAI researcher concerns over existential safety risks around the technology.

highlights.title: SK Hynix Says Exploring Options After Report of Intel Tie-Up
highlights.description: SK Hynix Inc. said that it’s exploring options to boost its global competitiveness after a report that it may team up with Intel Corp. to make semiconductors in the US.

highlights.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
highlights.description: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.

highlights.title: Meta CEO Zuckerberg Leans on Powell McCormick to Clear Path for AI Push
highlights.description: At a Meta Platforms Inc. board retreat last December, Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg asked Dina Powell McCormick to take a walk with him around his sprawling Kauai compound, known as Koolau Ranch.

highlights.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
highlights.description: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.

highlights.title: AWS tells clients to abandon Middle East data centers six months after Iranian drone strikes — Amazon offers no recovery timeline as UAE mulls underground data centers
highlights.description: Amazon Web Services' data centers in Abu Dhabi and Bahrain were struck by drone attacks more than six months ago. Now, the company has told customers to move their data to other regions, and it has no details on when repair work will be completed.

highlights.title: TikTok Billionaire Zhang Yiming Overtakes Gautam Adani as Asia’s Richest Person
highlights.description: ByteDance’s Zhang Yiming has become Asia’s richest person for the first time, marking a comeback for the TikTok developer as fortunes linked to artificial intelligence surge above the billionaires of traditional industry.
